== Research Notes ==

A possible identification concerns Andrew Allexander. The banns/marriage index records Joannet Glasgow and Andrew Allexander/ on 8 August 1661 at Glasgow.<ref>Scotland’s People: Old Parish Registers — banns and marriages: OPR 644 / 1/230 / 230; [https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk/ record].</ref> The original parish register image has not been inspected. The combined index date does not by itself identify the precise event type. The identification remains uncertain.
